svg.title: Bug 01: Portty, merged
svg.desc: Upstream contribution to chestso/portty pull request 9: Fix library paths and signing in macOS ZIPs. Live status: merged. Boss: zip mimic. The ZIP mimic flashes white, blinks and pops into sparks; its cracked signature seal snaps shut green and a spinning coin lands on the sealed crate. The boss's HP is empty.

g.text: FIX LIBRARY PATHS AND SIGNING IN MACOS ZIPS
